input: Set up a small home aquarium

gold.taskTitle: Set Up a Small Home Aquarium
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to set up a small aquarium at home, from choosing the tank to having it ready for fish.

questions.title: What size tank are you thinking, in gallons?
questions.description: Understanding the intended tank size shapes every downstream decision, from equipment to stocking.

questions.title: Will this be a freshwater or saltwater aquarium?
questions.description: The water type determines the complexity, cost, and equipment needed for the setup.

questions.title: Which specific fish or species do you want to keep?
questions.description: The chosen species affects tank size, water parameters, filtration, and compatibility planning.

questions.title: Where in your home will the tank be placed?
questions.description: The location affects stand requirements, light exposure, electrical access, and floor load considerations.

questions.title: Do you already own any aquarium equipment or supplies?
questions.description: Knowing what the user already has avoids recommending purchases they do not need.

questions.title: What is your budget for this entire setup?
questions.description: A budget range guides recommendations for tank, filter, heater, lighting, and decor.

questions.title: When do you want the tank ready for fish?
questions.description: A target date determines urgency and accounts for the nitrogen cycling period before fish are added.
